title: Hierarchical (folder tree) permissions: files inherit grants from ancestor folders
issue: A recursive CTE in the policy runs per row (no pull-up, no caching between rows) so listing files is O(files x depth). Fix = precomputed closure; cost moves to writes.
symptom: naive_rls (recursive EXISTS per file) is orders of magnitude slower than the closure/array variants.

scale.meaning: number of folders in a 3-ary tree (depth 10 at 50k); files = 2 x scale; scale/50 noise users each with 1-2 grants.
